card.title: IPhone 12 Stuck on the Apple Logo Error 4013 Repair

source.title: IPhone 12 Stuck on the Apple Logo Error 4013 Repair

claims.statement: iPhone 12 logo loops with error 4013 are almost always the earpiece flex (liquid on flood illuminator/ALS); unplug all flexes to confirm. Keep Face ID by cleaning or moving those parts.

procedure: Unplug all flexes; test with known-good screen, battery, port.
Repair or replace the earpiece flex.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
